hints.title: Contiguous Substring Deletion
hints.text: Removing characters to minimize the difference between maximum and minimum deleted index means removing one contiguous window from t.

hints.title: Suffix Match Precomputation
hints.text: For every suffix of t, compute the earliest rightward index in s that can form this suffix.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Combination
hints.text: Scan t from left to right matching prefixes against s. For each prefix match in s, match the longest compatible suffix using the precomputed array.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Matching Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear pass for right suffix indices and linear scan combining prefix with suffix.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all substring deletions of t against s takes O(m^2 * n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) space for the suffix index table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines greedy prefix matching with precomputed suffix matching.
